top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §744.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver didn't have their file available during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §744.3559(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection it was found that the drills were not documented.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Keep Records for 3 Months (26 TAC §744.3113(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The playground maintenance checklist was not available  during the inspection, with the most recent available checklist dated January 2024.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §744.3559(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was not a record of monthly fire drills conducted for licensing to review.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One food allergy plan was not signed by the parent.

top_violation_types.title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The classroom walls and window sills had pealing paint. In the Pre-K room one of the walls is stained and dirty. The peeling paint is in the reach of children. The floors in tile floors in the infant rooms are stained and dirty. This is not safe for the children to crawl on.

top_violation_types.title: Each caregiver, operation director, program director, and site director Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §744.1315(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was reviewed as a follow-up and found deficient as one caregiver did not have documentation of current CPR training.
